questions.subject: PSYCHOLOGY
questions.topic: Personality: What a Reliability Figure Is For
questions.stem: An engineer synthesizes how to use reliability figures when planning a personality study.

options.text: Ignore reliability if validity evidence exists.
Use reliability to set confidence intervals and plan sample size, not to claim validity.
Use reliability as the sole criterion for publishing results.
options.misconception: mistakes Use reliability as the sole criterion for publishing results for Use reliability to set confidence intervals and plan sample….

options.text: Reliability figures are only for test manuals, not studies.
options.misconception: it needs a label to be usable rather than standing on its own

questions.explanation: Reliability informs precision and planning, not validity claims. A fits; others overstate or dismiss. Superficially appealing, "Ignore reliability if validity evidence exists." is a common wrong turn: it dismisses reliability. Although plausible, "Use reliability as the sole criterion for publishing results." is a tempting but wrong choice: it overstates reliability. At first glance tempting, "Reliability figures are only for test manuals, not studies." looks reasonable but does not hold up: it needs a label to be usable rather than standing on its own.
